title: Filtered colimit of finitely generated etale subsheaves
statement: Let K be a separably closed field, X a finite-type K-scheme, and F an abelian etale sheaf on X supported at closed points [def-kun-support]. The full subcategory of subsheaves generated by finitely many sections on affine etale charts [def-kun-finitely-generated-etale-subsheaf] is filtered. There is a colimit cocone of its inclusion diagram whose vertex is isomorphic to F, with each leg followed by that isomorphism equal to the subsheaf inclusion.

proof.text: Use the sheafification adjunction, the free abelian group adjunction, and Yoneda to identify sections on a chart U with maps from the sheafified free representable on U. A section lifts to a subobject precisely when this map factors through it. Its image is therefore the least subsheaf containing the section. The empty family generates bottom. Concatenating two finite families shows that the join of two finitely generated subobjects is finitely generated. Bottom and joins make the full subcategory filtered; parallel maps agree since subobjects form a preorder.

The category of abelian etale sheaves is Grothendieck abelian. Well-poweredness makes the indexing category essentially small. Take its colimit and the canonical map to F. Exact filtered colimits applied to the natural monomorphism into the constant diagram show this map is monic (Mathlib colim.map_mono'). For a section on any chart and any point of the chart, choose an affine open neighbourhood. The restricted section belongs to its singly generated image subobject, so lifts through the colimit. The canonical map is locally surjective, hence epi, hence an isomorphism. Its colimit cocone and this isomorphism have the required equations.

lean.statement:
theorem closedPointSheaf_finitelyGenerated_filteredColimit
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [IsSepClosed K] (X : Scheme.{v})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (_hF : etaleSheafSupport F ⊆ {x | IsClosed ({x} : Set X)}) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (Subobject F) := IsFinitelyGeneratedEtaleSubsheaf
    IsFiltered P.FullSubcategory ∧
      (∃ (c : Cocone (P.ι ⋙ Subobject.underlying)) (e : c.pt ≅ F),
        Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ ∀ G : P.FullSubcategory,
          c.ι.app G ≫ e.hom = G.obj.arrow)
